name: incident advisor: final paired evaluation
scenario: pis.phase_b.scenarios.scenario_for(seed): spec and degradation fixed by the seed, not announced to any controller; 500 ms windows; every arm starts from the same policy

r6.role: reference: the R6 RL student, greedy (models/rl_r6/final.pt of the scheduler repo)

predictors.thresholds: conformal on the shadow run's calibration episodes (alpha 0.1, low = 0.7 x threshold), recomputed from its risks, never refitted on held-out episodes

metrics.cause: building_up = the incident's onset falls while a degradation is active; sudden otherwise
metrics.false_alarm_cost: paired (arm - r6) value_per_s over non-chronic episodes without a counted r6 incident
metrics.predictors_on_held_out: recall by cause at lead >= min_lead_windows, median lead, false-alarm rate, alarms per quiet episode, Brier of the window risk against the realised outcome (a new counted onset within H)

question_1.primary_choice: the learned predictor with the best building-up recall on the shadow run's SELECTION episodes (ties: lower false-alarm rate), fixed before any held-out run
question_1.rule: the primary learned predictor's held-out building-up recall minus that of the better non-learned predictor; success when the bootstrap 95% interval over episodes lies above zero. The other learned predictors are secondary: their intervals are reported, no success is claimed for them

success_rule.not_decidable: question 2 is not decidable (never a success) when any r6 or advisor run of the attempt failed; question 1 is not decidable when any r6 run or its predictor scoring failed (those episodes are excluded and counted)
success_rule.otherwise: any other result is reported as it is; an interval including zero is no detectable difference

failure_handling: a run that raises is recorded with a scrubbed message and listed, never dropped or replaced; pairs use the seeds where both arms ran. A crash or a bug: fix, rerun as the next attempt, report every attempt; no tuning on these results.
